name: Infinite Craft AI
desc:
» The Roblox remake of Infinite Craft (neal.fun) and Little Alchemy—a multiplayer crafting game powered by AI!
» Start with 💧 Water, 🌎 Earth, 🌬️ Wind and 🔥 Fire. Combine, merge, and craft elements to discover millions of new creations!

- Discover unlimited element combinations with AI
- Compete on global leaderboards
- Craft with friends in multiplayer mode
- Unlock badges and rare discoveries

🚀 PRIORITY QUEUE GAMEPASS 🚀
➛ Skip the queue with priority processing
➛ Craft two element pairs at once

👑 GROUP BENEFITS 👑
➛ Exclusive rewards (join Strongest Roblox Players)

📊 GAME INFO 📊
» 25M+ elements discovered by the community
» Both exploiting and creating inappropriate elements will result in a ban
» Disclaimer: Infinite Craft AI do not have the same recipes as neal.fun's Infinite Craft.
